items.title: Albert Warner Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: I first went to By Road School down at, uh... Durny and Governor Nicholas. Well, used to call it By Road Street then, back in those days.

ctx.x: The Robertson School. I first went to By Road School down at, uh... Durny and Governor Nicholas. Well, used to call it By Road Street then, back in those days. Mm-hmm. See?
Governor Nicholas was called By Road? Yeah.

Back in those days it was By Road Street, you see? Mm-hmm. Now they called it Governor Nicholas. Mm-hmm. But that was an old break building was there. Now they got a new school there, you see. You got a new school there. See, well, way back in that time they had all white teachers in there. Mm-hmm. Well, after they moved us from there, they moved us up to Bienville and Roberson, the old Roberson school across from the cemetery. These were public schools? Public schools, yeah. See, then from that school, and then…
